limitation.title: Petition for special leave to appeal: 90 days from the date of the judgment or order
limitation.from: the date of the judgment or order appealed from
limitation.source: Supreme Court Rules, 2013, Order XXI rule 1, as recorded in the in-sc adapter's limitation list; the advocate confirms each working

requiredParts: Certified copy of the impugned judgment
annexureParts: Certified copy of the impugned judgment

workflow.text: Analyse the impugned judgment and report its findings with anchors.
Check the chronology for contradictions and confirm the dates.
Generate the List of Dates from the confirmed events.
Propose the issues and decide them at the case conference.
Work out the limitation from the impugned judgment; confirm the working.
Draft the petition from the approved Questions of Law and Grounds.
Review the drafts, their citations and their grounding.
Run the filing checklist and the format checks.
Approve for filing; the filing set and its signed manifest are made.

intakeQuestions: What is the date of the impugned judgment?

Was an earlier SLP filed against the same judgment?
Does a letters patent or writ appeal lie, and was it availed?
